items.title: Approve the Minutes of the June 24, 2025 Meeting
Approve the Fiscal Year 2025/26 Transportation Fund for Clean Air Program of Projects,Totaling $723,264, with Conditions
Adopt the Walter U Lum Place Public Space Study Final Report
Allocate $2,441,000 and Appropriate $100,000 in Prop L Funds, with Conditions, and Allocate $2,360,572 in Prop AA Funds, with Conditions, for Six Requests
Program $5,672,505 in TNC Tax Funds to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for Three Application-Based Residential Traffic Calming Projects, with Conditions
Allocate $6,887,505 in TNC Tax Funds, with Conditions, to the San Francisco Municipal Transportation Agency for Three Projects
Approve a Two-Year Professional Services Contract with SITELAB urban studio in an Amount Not to Exceed $1,100,000 for Consultant Services for the Geary-Filmore Underpass Community Planning Study
Award Contracts to Five Shortlisted Consultant Teams for a Three-Year Period, for On-Call Strategic Communications, Media and Community Relations Services
Approve Revised Debt Policy and Ratify Investment Policy
